blurb: Muskoka Boat Rentals offers a variety of boats including Sea-Doos, Bow-Riders, Pontoons, Tri-Toons, and Ski/Wake Surf Boats for rent on lakes such as Muskoka, Joseph, Simcoe, Rosseau, and Ontario. Rentals range from short term (2 hours minimum) to long term, with various models and horsepower options. Accessories like water skis, wakeboards, tubes, and surfboards are also available for rent.
extraNote: Rental deposit required to guarantee reservation; 25% deposit minimum $300 · Cancellation over 30 days: $300 or 25% charge; under 30 days: credit valid for one year · No refund for weather conditions · Late pick up or drop off fee $75 per half hour unless notified 24 hours prior · Security deposit $3,000 for boats under 23.5 ft, $5,000 for 24 ft and over or dual propellers, $10,000 for specialty boats

quotes.author: Kat Vaih
quotes.text: The staff here at Muskoka Boat Rentals are awesome, even though we did have to wait quite a bit for the boat inspection due to the short staff, they were able to serve us as quickly as possible, once it was our turn. I don’t have a boat license which did make things a bit trickier, however I did get instructions and a day boat license from the company. Make sure you address all you questions before you leave the dock or get the boat, so that there are no disappointments afterwards. Very happy with these guys!Kat VaihMBR Customer

quotes.author: Teresa Noel
quotes.text: What an amazing trip to Muskoka, we never had the chance to get bored thanks to Boat Rentals Canada. I recommend renting from them, nice modern boats.Teresa Noel Customer
